title: Google Cloud Skills Boost platform plan — D1
purpose: Architecture map for Google Cloud Skills Boost platform plan: learning-path sequencing, hands-on labs, budget alerts, project safety, checkpoints, and evidence capture.
routing_rationale: Use the D1 lens to keep learning-path sequencing, hands-on labs, budget alerts, project safety, checkpoints, and evidence capture connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Sequence Cloud Skills Boost learning paths and specialist quests into an evidence-backed architect practice plan.

nodes.label: Learner Goal
nodes.detail: The outcome that determines which learning path is next.

nodes.label: Cloud Digital Leader
nodes.detail: Business framing and low-pressure cloud vocabulary.

nodes.label: Cloud Engineer Path
nodes.detail: Hands-on networking, compute, storage, and operations foundation.

nodes.label: PCA Learning Path
nodes.detail: Architecture trade-offs, case analysis, and exam preparation.

nodes.label: Specialist Quests
nodes.detail: Optional depth after the core path.

nodes.label: Disposable Lab Project
nodes.detail: A guarded project with region, IAM, budget, and cleanup controls.

nodes.label: Evidence Log
nodes.detail: Proof of what was learned and what remains to verify.

scenarios.label: A learner skips the foundation
scenarios.root_cause: Advanced labs are attempted without the networking or IAM model needed to explain them.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Google Cloud Skills Boost platform plan path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Cloud Engineer Path and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Return to the prerequisite path and record the missing concept.

check.command: review d1 evidence for Cloud Engineer Path

scenarios.label: A lab project has no guardrails
scenarios.root_cause: Credentials, budget, region, or cleanup controls are missing.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Google Cloud Skills Boost platform plan path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Disposable Lab Project and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Set the project guard, budget alert, least privilege, and destroy step first.

scenarios.label: Completion cannot be demonstrated
